title: Effect of Selenium on Serum Adiponectin, Homocystein and Malnutrition-inflammation Complex Syndrome in Hemodialysis Patients
brief_summary: The aim of this study is to determine the effect of selenium supplementation as an antioxidant on serum adiponectin, HSCRP , ferritin , transferrin, albumin and homocysteine level.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients who were dialysed three times a week for at least 3 months or more

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients who took multivitamins or immunosuppressive medications
* Patients consuming antioxidant supplements including vitamin E, vitamin C, lipoic acid, omega-3 fatty acids, soy extracts and green-tea preparations
* Patients who had active infection
* Patients who were hospitalized in the previous month.
* Being Pregnant
